On 13.04.2023 the appeal was admitted .
With the consent of both the learned counsel for the appellant as well as respondent No.3, the case is finally heard.

2. This appeal under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 h a s been filed by the appellant/claimant against impugned award dated 07.07.2021 passed by the Nineteenth Additional Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur [for short "Tribunal"] in MACC No. 2614/2018 ( Sheikh Saleem Vs.

entities.text: Nineteenth Additional Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Sheikh Hussain and Ors.)
. The Tribunal awarded compensation of Rs. 3,78,000/-on account of serious injuries to the claimant.
The present appeal has been filed seeking enhancement of Rs.1,00,000/- by paying court fee of Rs.2,500/-.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that on account of mental and physical pain Rs.25,000/- has been granted.

It is further submitted that Rs.10,000/- for special diet and Rs.
25,000/- for future treatment have been awarded.
It is informed that appellant-claimant remained in hospital for 12 days.
Income has been taken as Rs.6,000/- per month but on the date of incident minimum wages was Rs.7325/- per month.
Therefore, compensation needs to be enhanced as trial Court has awarded less compensation.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record and appreciated the impugned award.
5.

Considering the over all facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that the compensation needs to be enhanced and accordingly, Rs.20,000/- under each head is enhanced viz.
future treatment, special diet, physical & mental pain and loss of earning.

Thus, the compensation amount is enhanced by a lumpsum amount of Rs. 80,000/- (Rs.
Eighty Thousand Only).
The rate of interest and other conditions on the enhanced amount shall be as awarded by the Tribunal.
6. In the result, the appeal is partly allowed.

(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE nks Shekh Saleem vs Shekh Hussain on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22341995/
